messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer reports console shows 1,500 trial credits but the API usage/billing shows no credits applied and charges keep accruing.
acme_devops: Confirmed. Console org-level view shows 1500 credits, project's service key reports 0 available. This started after we did a project migration last Tuesday.
maria_support: Can you paste a project_id + a sample request id so we can repro?
acme_devops: Project: proj-88a2, sample request id: req_20260310_43f.
liam_billing: Quick lookup — promo grant exists in credits_service for org_id=org-77 but grant.target_scope == "org" and the metering path expects a project-scoped grant or an explicit project mapping. Migration script forgot to populate project alias mapping for legacy org grants.
sre_oncall: @metering-bot kick off a resync for org-77 so the billing ledger can re-evaluate mappings.
metering-bot: POST /internal/credits/resync?org_id=org-77 returned job_id=jb_993, status=queued.
liam_billing: Repro steps I used locally:
1) Query console API: GET https://console.redwood.ai/api/orgs/org-77/credits -> {"available":1500} 
2) Query service key: curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits -> {"available":0} 
3) Check ledger: SELECT * FROM credit_grants WHERE org_id='org-77' AND promo_id='promo_2026_trial'; shows scope='org' and no project_alias entries.
maria_support: Customer asked for ETA and a temporary workaround.
liam_billing: Workaround (admin action): attach the promo to the project via the admin endpoint to make it visible to service keys immediately: 
```
POST /internal/admin/credits/attach
Content-Type: application/json
{ "promo_id": "promo_2026_trial", "project_id": "proj-88a2" }
```
Note: requires admin token.
sre_oncall: Resync job completed: job_id=jb_993, status=completed, mapped_delta=1500.
acme_devops: Verified — subsequent API call with service key now returns {"available":1500} and token usage deducts from credits. Thanks!
maria_support: I'll keep this open for 24h to monitor for regressions and then close. Adding action item to ensure migration script includes project_alias population. :thumbsup: 
liam_billing: Created ENG-5643 to add a one-time migration fix and add unit tests for mapping logic.
sre_oncall: Also adding an alert to catch mismatched grant scopes during migration windows.
maria_support: Closing loop with customer and updating ticket notes. Thread resolved.
